blurb: Silver Lake Marina offers wet slips and dry storage for boats with access to 30 acres of lakefront park property on Lake Grapevine. Amenities include covered and uncovered slips, dock boxes, shorepower hookups, pumpout, freshwater hookups, boat lifts, and a fuel dock with premium 93 octane fuel. The marina also features a lakefront restaurant, a ship store, showers, restrooms, and gated access.
